1.t: By the night when it covers

2.t: and the day when it shines

3.t: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female

4.t: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse

5.t: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺

6.t: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward

7.t: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease

8.t: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺

10.t: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship

11.t: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺

12.t: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance

13.t: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next

14.t: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire

15.t: in which none will burn except the most wretched—

17.t: But the righteous will be spared from it—

18.t: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves

19.t: not in return for someone’s favours

20.t: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High
